author: Muse (port)
Cryptid team (original mod)
description: 179 Jokers and 34 consumables ported from Cryptid by the Cryptid team (SpectralPack), including the Epic, Exotic, Candy and Cursed rarities, the Bulwark and UltPair poker hands, the Code and Unique consumable types, and registered Green/Azure seals, Astral/Mosaic/M editions and Cat/Double M/Rework tags. Requires the Balatro3DS fork's Tier 1 + Tier 2 + Tier 3 mod APIs (create/destroy cards, retrigger returns, SMODS.Rarity, SMODS.PokerHand, SMODS.ConsumableType, SMODS.Seal/Edition/Tag, Joker-targeting consumables, e_mult/e_chips/x_chips/balance returns) and its Wave 1 systems (G.jokers_sold, the game_over context, joker_type_destroyed) and its Wave 5 systems (SMODS.copy_joker, SMODS.blueprint_effect) and its Wave 6 shop / voucher / booster APIs (SMODS.multiply_shop_prices, SMODS.queue_next_booster_bonus, SMODS.grant_voucher / SMODS.unredeem_voucher) and its Wave 7b enhancement channels (enhancement retrigger query, per-card enhancement state, check_enhancement, destroy question, identity fields). 88 Cryptid items stay blocked; see README.txt.
name: Cryptid Pack
